court: In the High Court of Madras
judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

V. Parthiban, J.:— At the hearing, the learned counsel on both sides would submit that the parties have settled the matter amicably among themselves. The learned counsel for the appellants has also made an endorsement to the said effect.

2. Recording the same, this Second Appeal is dismissed as settled out of Court. No costs.
